notes:
REF-BM-02: Only the page title is collected; description, favicon, and preview image are missing.
REF-BM-03: Title is editable before and after saving, but description is unsupported.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, tags, and note are editable, but description is unsupported.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are rejected and an existing ID is returned, but the UI does not guide or open the existing bookmark for editing.
REF-BM-07: The list exposes title and tags, but not description or favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag-entry fields provide no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, URL, and note, but no description field exists.
REF-BM-14: The #tag search syntax is not parsed.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesized groups are not implemented.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are treated as literal text including quotation marks.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk actions exist.
REF-BM-21: No whole-filtered-collection bulk action exists.
REF-BM-22: Results use a fixed newest-first order with no user-selectable sorting.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed, but Markdown is rendered only as plain text.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are not implemented.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-26: Bookmark archiving is not implemented.
REF-BM-27: Only permanent deletion exists; reversible archiving does not.
REF-BM-28: No archived-bookmarks view exists.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are not implemented.
